<documents>
<document id="travel-blocked-regions">
Countriesˆwhereˆcardsˆdon'tˆworkˆTallowbrookˆcardsˆdon'tˆworkˆinˆcomprehensivelyˆsanctionedˆcountriesˆandˆregions.ˆPurchases,ˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆandˆonlineˆordersˆfromˆmerchantsˆbasedˆthereˆareˆdeclined.ˆ##ˆWhyˆUSˆbanksˆandˆcardˆprogramsˆmustˆfollowˆUSˆsanctionsˆrules.ˆWeˆcan'tˆmakeˆexceptions,ˆandˆsupportˆcan'tˆunblockˆaˆsanctionedˆlocationˆforˆyou.ˆ##ˆSigningˆinˆfromˆabroadˆYouˆcanˆusuallyˆuseˆtheˆappˆfromˆanywhere,ˆbutˆaccessˆfromˆaˆsanctionedˆlocationˆmayˆbeˆblockedˆandˆcouldˆleadˆtoˆaˆreviewˆofˆyourˆaccount.ˆ##ˆDeclinedˆsomewhereˆelse?ˆIfˆyou'reˆinˆaˆcountryˆthatˆisn'tˆsanctionedˆandˆyourˆcardˆisˆdeclined,ˆtheˆcauseˆisˆmoreˆlikelyˆaˆfraudˆcheck,ˆyourˆcardˆcontrols,ˆorˆyourˆbalance.ˆSeeˆ"Whyˆwasˆmyˆcardˆdeclined?".ˆ##ˆSendingˆmoneyˆabroadˆInternationalˆwiresˆtoˆsanctionedˆcountriesˆareˆalsoˆblocked.ˆWiresˆtoˆotherˆcountriesˆmayˆstillˆbeˆreviewedˆbeforeˆthey'reˆsent.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="referrals">
ReferˆaˆfriendˆWhenˆaˆfriendˆopensˆaˆTallowbrookˆaccountˆwithˆyourˆinviteˆlinkˆandˆqualifies,ˆyouˆeachˆgetˆ$25.00.ˆ##ˆHowˆyourˆfriendˆqualifiesˆTheyˆneedˆtoˆreceiveˆatˆleastˆ$500ˆinˆdirectˆdepositsˆwithinˆ60ˆdaysˆofˆopeningˆtheirˆaccount.ˆ##ˆWhenˆyou'reˆpaidˆBothˆbonusesˆareˆpaidˆwithinˆ5ˆbusinessˆdaysˆofˆyourˆfriendˆqualifying.ˆ##ˆYourˆinviteˆlinkˆTapˆProfile,ˆthenˆInviteˆfriends.ˆShareˆtheˆlinkˆanyˆwayˆyouˆlike.ˆYourˆfriendˆhasˆtoˆuseˆtheˆlinkˆwhenˆtheyˆsignˆup.ˆWeˆcan'tˆaddˆaˆreferralˆafterward.ˆ##ˆRulesˆ-ˆYourˆfriendˆmustˆbeˆnewˆtoˆTallowbrook.ˆ-ˆYouˆcan'tˆreferˆyourselfˆorˆopenˆaˆsecondˆaccount.ˆ-ˆReferralˆbonusesˆmayˆbeˆreportedˆtoˆtaxˆauthorities.ˆ##ˆDidn'tˆgetˆyourˆbonus?ˆCheckˆyourˆfriendˆusedˆyourˆlinkˆandˆreceivedˆtheˆdirectˆdepositsˆinˆtime.ˆIfˆtheyˆdid,ˆmessageˆsupport.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="plans-compare">
Compareˆplans:ˆfeaturesˆandˆlimitsˆAllˆthreeˆplansˆcomeˆwithˆaˆVisaˆdebitˆcard,ˆtheˆTallowbrookˆapp,ˆBrookPayˆtransfersˆtoˆotherˆmembers,ˆSavingsˆPocketsˆandˆsupportˆaroundˆtheˆclock.ˆTheyˆdifferˆinˆfees,ˆlimitsˆandˆaˆfewˆfeatures.ˆ|ˆFeatureˆ|ˆBasicˆ|ˆPlusˆ|ˆPremiumˆ|ˆ|---|---|---|---|ˆ|ˆCardˆ|ˆplasticˆ|ˆplasticˆ|ˆmetalˆ|ˆ|ˆSavingsˆAPYˆ|ˆ0.50%ˆ|ˆ2.00%ˆ|ˆ3.75%ˆ|ˆ|ˆCushionˆ|ˆnotˆavailableˆ|ˆupˆtoˆ$50.00ˆ|ˆupˆtoˆ$200ˆ|ˆ|ˆDailyˆcardˆspendingˆ|ˆ$3,000ˆ|ˆ$5,000ˆ|ˆ$10,000ˆ|ˆ|ˆDailyˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆ|ˆ$500ˆ|ˆ$1,000ˆ|ˆ$1,500ˆ|ˆ|ˆDailyˆACHˆtransfersˆoutˆ|ˆ$2,500ˆ|ˆ$5,000ˆ|ˆ$10,000ˆ|ˆ|ˆOutgoingˆinternationalˆwiresˆ|ˆnotˆavailableˆ|ˆyesˆ|ˆyesˆ|ˆ|ˆEmergencyˆcardˆabroadˆ|ˆnoˆ|ˆnoˆ|ˆyesˆ|ˆFeesˆareˆlistedˆinˆtheˆarticleˆ"Feesˆforˆallˆplans".ˆThisˆpageˆcoversˆfeaturesˆandˆlimitsˆonly.ˆ##ˆWhichˆplanˆfitsˆBasicˆsuitsˆpeopleˆwhoˆmostlyˆuseˆBrookLinkˆATMsˆandˆdon'tˆtravel.ˆPlusˆsuitsˆpeopleˆwhoˆwantˆCushionˆandˆaˆbetterˆsavingsˆrateˆforˆaˆsmallˆmonthlyˆfee.ˆPremiumˆsuitsˆfrequentˆtravelersˆandˆpeopleˆwithˆlargerˆbalances,ˆsinceˆtheˆsavingsˆrateˆandˆtheˆmissingˆforeignˆfeesˆcanˆmoreˆthanˆcoverˆtheˆmonthlyˆfee.ˆYouˆcanˆswitchˆplansˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆtime.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
</documents>
